name: The Short-Baseline Near Detector at Fermilab

summary.plain: The paper describing the SBND detector, a 112-tonne liquid-argon camera just 110 metres from the Fermilab neutrino source.
summary.technical: arXiv:2504.00245 (FERMILAB-PUB-25-0154-PPD): design and initial operation of the Short-Baseline Near Detector, a 112 t active-mass single-phase LArTPC 110 m from the BNB target, the near detector of the SBN programme.
